checks.name: identity
checks.reason: The supplied views consistently show the rounded workshop robot, cream faceplate, blue panels, copper fittings and small mechanical details.

checks.name: appearance
checks.reason: Native and exported appearances retain the requested palette and polished metal toy finish. No fur is requested.

checks.name: framing
checks.reason: The full body, feet and raised hand remain inside the sampled frames.

checks.name: deformation
checks.reason: Raised-arm poses show a long thin copper-colored spike extending down from the wrist/forearm and a stretched blue wedge near the shoulder. Both defects appear in native, exported and delivered samples.

limitations: Motion is supplied as a contact sheet; individual full-resolution peak poses are unavailable for detailed joint inspection.
Sampled images and supplied measurements do not establish continuous collision freedom, physical support or seamless looping.
Original source identity cannot be independently compared because no separate source appearance reference is supplied.
required_repairs: Inspect and correct right shoulder, forearm and wrist vertex assignments so raising and waving the hand does not stretch panel geometry into spikes or wedges; preserve the original mechanical details.
Supply full-resolution native and exported peak-pose images after repair, including side views of the raised arm.

state_reviews.reason: The raised right hand alternates orientation in a recognizable greeting, but conspicuous arm deformation prevents acceptance.

requirement_reviews.reason: Repeated hand changes are visible and the supplied audit reports articulation, but stretched wrist/forearm and shoulder geometry breaks the arm silhouette during the wave.
The torso stays in the same sampled position and orientation; the supplied audit reports zero sampled world displacement for its selected surfaces.
Both feet retain their sampled positions without visible stepping or sliding, consistent with reported zero sampled world displacement. Physical ground contact remains unverified.

summary: The robot appearance and greeting meaning are preserved, but the raised right arm develops conspicuous stretched geometry across all supplied motion representations.
